name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: UI SDK Dialog parts: focus trap, Escape, focus restore, dismissible and controller support.
docs: Focus returns to whatever opened the dialog. `DialogContent` records the focused element as it opens, so focus still comes back when the dialog leaves the page while open (`{open && <Dialog open>…</Dialog>}`) and when a field inside has React's `autoFocus`, which takes focus before UI SDK records where it came from. To choose the first field, pass `initialFocus` to `DialogContent` (a selector like `"#name"`, an element, or a function), not `autoFocus`: it is how UI SDK decides where focus starts, and after a touch press it focuses the dialog itself so no on-screen keyboard pops up. Prefer keeping the `Dialog` mounted and driving `open`: an unmounted dialog skips its exit transition. `finalFocus` overrides where focus returns; `"none"` leaves it alone, also on unmount. While the dialog animates out, its backdrop and content are inert (UI SDK) and `pointer-events: none`, so the first click on the page after closing lands. ConfirmDialog, FormDialog, CommandDialog and Drawer share all of this.
